blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Finance (DOF) is hoping to file the long-delayed general tax amnesty program in Congress by the end of the year, according to Finance Undersecretary Rolando Ligon. “We are fine-tuning the draft. We still need more information to ensure the amnesty is successful. We need to address the additional taxes that we need to collect,” Ligon told reporters. READ: DOF weighs tax amnesty plan covering liabilities from 2007 “Hopefully, we will be able to file it this year. Then next year, the hearing can start,” he added.
